selection_rule: Among assisted candidates with complete official grades and complete native cost accounting, choose highest resolved count, then lowest total published-rate model-cost scenario. Freeze selection and all prompts before held-out inference. Report both candidates and their independent control repeats; no best-of merging of task attempts.
cheap_control: Compare strengthened Luna-only with each assisted candidate; do not attribute shared prompting gains to delegation.
fallback_rule: Initial independent attempt plus visible check; one materially different unsuccessful repair attempt, or no credible approach after initial inspection, triggers a consultation while integration budget remains.
additional_revisions: If a later revision is necessary, register a new candidate and retain all earlier runs before scoring it. Never tune on held-out outcomes.
external_baselines: Published benchmarks are context; paired local controls support retention estimates.
amendment: Add compact context-only expert interface before any v2 development grades or held-out inference. Existing candidates, prompts and scored assignment lists remain unchanged.
compact_difference: Same adaptive controller policy and acting agents; only context-only expert/router built-in instructions replaced using documented model_instructions_file. All permissions and tool exclusions preserved.
